tutorial.rsvp.title: RSVP
tutorial.rsvp.desc: Words appear one at a time in the center of the screen. The highlighted focus letter (ORP) guides your eye to the optimal reading point.
tutorial.wpm.title: Speed (WPM)
tutorial.wpm.desc: Reading speed ranges from 50 to 1000 words per minute. Adjust it anytime in Settings → Reading → Base speed.
tutorial.pause.title: Pause
tutorial.pause.desc: Three pause modes: Tap pauses at end of sentence, Hold pauses at end of sentence, Auto pauses instantly on touch.
tutorial.hud.title: HUD
tutorial.hud.desc: Three elements visible while reading: battery level, chapter name, and progress percent. Toggle each independently in Settings.
tooltip.readingMode.desc: Choose between RSVP (one word at a time) or page scroll mode.
tooltip.readingMode.effect: Changes how text is displayed on the device screen.
tooltip.pauseBehaviour.desc: Controls how pausing works during reading.
tooltip.pauseBehaviour.effect: Tap/Hold pause at sentence end; Auto pauses instantly.
tooltip.baseWpm.desc: Base reading speed in words per minute.
tooltip.longWordDelay.desc: Extra display time for longer words.
tooltip.longWordDelay.effect: Gives more time to read lengthy words.
tooltip.complexWordDelay.desc: Extra time for complex words (hyphens, numbers).
tooltip.fontSize.effect: Larger text is easier to read but shows fewer context words.
tooltip.typeface.effect: Atkinson aids low vision; OpenDyslexic aids dyslexia.
tooltip.phantomWords.desc: Dimmed context words shown around the current word.
tooltip.phantomWords.effect: Provides surrounding text context while reading in RSVP.
tooltip.focusHighlight.desc: Highlights the center letter of each word in color.
tooltip.focusHighlight.effect: Guides your eye to the optimal recognition point (ORP).
tooltip.anchor.desc: Vertical position of the current word on screen.
tooltip.anchor.effect: Lower values place the word higher, leaving room below.
tooltip.guideWidth.desc: Width of horizontal guide lines beside the word.
tooltip.guideWidth.effect: Wider lines help focus your eye on the reading area.
tooltip.guideGap.desc: Gap between the word and the guide lines.
tooltip.guideGap.effect: Smaller gap places guides closer to the word.
tooltip.theme.desc: App color scheme: Light, Dark, or Night.
tooltip.theme.effect: Night mode uses warm colors and reduced brightness.
tooltip.brightness.effect: Night mode caps brightness at 55% to protect your eyes.
tooltip.readerHand.effect: Moves controls and anchor position for your grip.
tooltip.footerLabel.desc: What the footer shows during reading.
tooltip.footerLabel.effect: Choose percent read, chapter time, or book time.
tooltip.batteryLabel.effect: Show percentage, time remaining, or voltage.
tooltip.screensaver.desc: Animation shown when device is idle.
tooltip.screensaver.effect: Choose Life, Maze, Voronoi, or screen off.
tooltip.readingBattery.effect: Disabling gives more screen space for text.
tooltip.readingChapter.effect: Displays current chapter at the top of the screen.
tooltip.readingPercent.effect: Displays how far you are through the book.
tooltip.focusColor.desc: Color of the highlighted focus letter.
tooltip.focusColor.effect: Choose from 6 colors; Night mode uses warm tones.
tooltip.saveBtn.desc: Save point button visible during reading.
tooltip.saveBtn.effect: Tap to bookmark your current position.
help.quickstart.title: Quick Start
help.quickstart.connect: Open the app, enable Bluetooth on your phone, and tap Connect. The reader will pair automatically via BLE.
help.quickstart.sendBook: Use the Converter tab to import an EPUB, PDF, TXT, MD, or HTML file. The app converts it to .rsvp format and sends it to your device.
help.quickstart.startReading: On the device, select a book from the library and tap to start reading. Tap to pause, swipe up/down to change speed.
help.display.theme.name: Theme
help.display.theme.desc: Sets the color scheme of the interface: Light (bright background), Dark (dark background), or Night (warm tones, reduced brightness).
help.display.brightness.name: Brightness
help.display.brightness.desc: Controls screen brightness. In Night mode, maximum is capped at 55% to reduce eye strain.
help.display.readerHand.name: Reader hand
help.display.readerHand.desc: Indicates which hand holds the device. Adjusts control placement and text anchor position accordingly.
help.display.footerLabel.name: Footer label
help.display.footerLabel.desc: Determines what information appears in the footer during reading: percent read, estimated chapter time, or book time.
help.display.batteryLabel.name: Battery label
help.display.batteryLabel.desc: Chooses how battery status is displayed: percentage, estimated time remaining, or raw voltage.
help.display.screensaver.name: Screensaver
help.display.screensaver.desc: Animation shown when the device is idle. Game of Life, maze generation, Voronoi diagram, or screen off for power saving.
help.display.readingBattery.name: Reading battery
help.display.readingBattery.desc: Toggles battery icon visibility in the reading HUD. Hiding it gives more screen space to text.
help.display.readingChapter.name: Reading chapter
help.display.readingChapter.desc: Toggles chapter name visibility in the reading HUD. Shows which chapter you are currently reading.
help.display.readingPercent.name: Reading percent
help.display.readingPercent.desc: Toggles progress percentage visibility in the reading HUD. Shows how far through the book you are.
help.display.focusColor.name: Focus color
help.display.focusColor.desc: Color used to highlight the ORP (focus letter) and guide elements. Night mode shifts colors to warmer tones.
help.display.focusColor.values: Red, Blue, Green, Yellow, Orange, Purple
help.display.saveBtn.name: Save button
help.display.saveBtn.desc: Controls visibility of the save point button during reading. Tap it to create a bookmark at the current position.
help.reading.readingMode.name: Reading mode
help.reading.readingMode.desc: RSVP shows one word at a time with controlled pacing. Page scroll displays text in pages you navigate manually.
help.reading.pauseBehaviour.name: Pause behaviour
help.reading.pauseBehaviour.desc: Tap mode pauses at end of sentence on short touch. Hold mode pauses at end of sentence on long press. Auto pauses instantly.
help.reading.baseWpm.name: Base speed (WPM)
help.reading.baseWpm.desc: Base reading speed in words per minute. Adjustable from 50 to 1000 WPM via slider or swipe gesture during reading.
help.reading.longWordDelay.name: Long word delay
help.reading.longWordDelay.desc: Additional display time for longer words. Gives you more time to process them before the next word appears.
help.reading.complexWordDelay.name: Complexity delay
help.reading.complexWordDelay.desc: Extra display time for complex words containing hyphens, numbers, or special characters.
help.reading.punctuationDelay.name: Punctuation delay
help.reading.punctuationDelay.desc: Extra pause after punctuation marks (period, comma, exclamation). Simulates natural speech pauses.
help.reading.fontSize.name: Font size
help.reading.fontSize.desc: Size of text on the e-ink display. Larger sizes improve readability but reduce visible phantom word context.
help.reading.typeface.name: Typeface
help.reading.typeface.desc: Font used for rendering text. Standard is serif. Atkinson Hyperlegible aids low vision. OpenDyslexic helps with dyslexia.
help.reading.phantomWords.name: Phantom words
help.reading.phantomWords.desc: Dimmed context words shown before and after the current word. Amount varies by font size. RSVP mode only.
help.reading.focusHighlight.name: Focus highlight
help.reading.focusHighlight.desc: Highlights the ORP (center letter) in color to guide your eye. Works in both RSVP and scroll modes.
help.reading.tracking.name: Tracking
help.reading.tracking.desc: Adjusts spacing between letters. Positive values spread letters apart; negative values compress them.
help.reading.anchor.name: Anchor
help.reading.anchor.desc: Vertical position of the word on screen as percentage from top. Left-hand mode shifts it down by 20%.
help.reading.guideWidth.name: Guide width
help.reading.guideWidth.desc: Width of the horizontal guide lines displayed on each side of the current word to help focus your eye.
help.reading.guideGap.name: Guide gap
help.reading.guideGap.desc: Vertical distance between the word and the guide lines. Smaller values bring the lines closer.
help.hud.readingBattery.name: Reading battery
help.hud.readingBattery.desc: Shows or hides the battery indicator during active reading. Hiding it frees screen space for text.
help.hud.readingChapter.name: Reading chapter
help.hud.readingChapter.desc: Shows or hides the current chapter name during reading. Useful for long books with many chapters.
help.hud.readingPercent.name: Reading percent
help.hud.readingPercent.desc: Shows or hides the book completion percentage during reading.
help.language.uiLang.name: Interface language
help.language.uiLang.desc: Language used for all menus, labels, and messages on the device and in the app.
help.language.uiLang.values: English, Spanish, French, German, Romanian, Polish
help.connection.bluetooth.name: Phone sync (Bluetooth)
help.connection.bluetooth.desc: Enables BLE so the device is discoverable by the Flower app on your phone. Stays active between restarts once enabled.
help.connection.wifi.name: Wi-Fi
help.connection.wifi.desc: Connect to a home network for OTA firmware updates and RSS feed downloads. Requires developer mode.
hint.reading.text: Tap to pause reading, swipe up/down to change speed. Tap the back arrow to return to the menu.
hint.converter.text: Import EPUB, PDF, TXT, MD, or HTML files. They are converted to .rsvp format and sent to your device.
